title: Relative Clauses: Who, Which, That

vocab.ex: The colleague who helped me is very kind.
I need someone who is reliable.
The man who called is my brother.
The car, which is new, is mine.
The book that I read was amazing.
In 'the man who called', 'man' is the antecedent.
This is the tool that I use every day.
She is a person who is very generous.
The woman who called is my boss.
The book that I read was great.
The car which is parked outside is mine.
The man who works here is very kind.
The movie that we watched was boring.
The girl who sings in the choir is my niece.
The phone which broke is only a year old.
The restaurant that closed was my favorite.
The teacher who explained the lesson was patient.
The dog that barks all night belongs to my neighbor.
The house which we bought needs some repairs.
The friend who helped me moved away last year.
The email that arrived this morning was important.
The singer who performed was amazing.
The company which hired her is very famous.
The shoes that I bought yesterday are too small.
The neighbor who complained lives upstairs.
The meeting that started late ran over.
The doctor who examined me was very thorough.
The story which surprised us was true.
The app that I downloaded is very useful.
The plan which failed cost us a lot of time.

expressions.example: I need someone who can fix my computer.
This isn't the one that I ordered.
Family is something that really matters to me.
She told me everything that happened at the party.

sentences: The woman who called is my boss.

grammar.title: Relative Clauses: Who, Which, That
rules: Who se refere a pessoas: The man who called is my brother.
Which se refere a coisas ou animais: The car which broke down is old.
That pode se referir a pessoas ou coisas, é mais informal e comum na fala: The book that I read...
O pronome relativo pode ser omitido quando é objeto da oração: The book (that) I read was great.

rows: The man who called is my brother.
The car which broke down is old.
The book that I read was great.

quiz.q: The woman ___ called is my boss.
The car ___ is parked outside is mine.
The book ___ I read last week was amazing.
I need someone ___ can help me.
The restaurant ___ closed was my favorite.
